name: How do I choose the right contractor for an accessible bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for an accessible bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for an accessible bathroom renovation, look for experience in universal design and ADA compliance. Verify their licensing and insurance, and check references or reviews from previous clients who had similar projects. A good contractor will conduct a thorough assessment, provide a detailed proposal, and communicate clearly throughout the process. Prioritize those who demonstrate an understanding of accessibility needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in universal design and ADA compliance, valid licensing, and good references. Ensure they provide detailed proposals and clear communication.
